description: A network of single track off road motorcycle trails that traverse various terrains and forest types allowing for all levels of riders.
directions: Head North of Williams Lake for approximately 17km, turn left onto Bull Mountain Road (Hwy signs for Bull Mtn Cross Country Ski Trails), immediately after the cattle guard turn right onto the Smokey Mtn FSR,,, follow this to 4.5km, turn left into the small staging areas.
title: Bull Mountain Motorcycle
